summary: Baosheng Media Group Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated August 20, 2026, announcing a strategic cooperation memorandum of understanding with 58.com Group covering AI marketing, AI advertising, virtual human livestreaming, intelligent media buying, omnichannel content distribution and smart local services. No equity stake, price per share, premium, financing, board recommendation or advisor were disclosed, and the MOU is non-binding and expressly furnished rather than filed. Structurally this is an ordinary foreign-private-issuer commercial collaboration, not an acquisition, tender, spin-off or capital event, so no deal terms are stated. Watch for any definitive agreement, revenue contribution or conversion of the MOU into an equity or JV transaction; near-term risk-arb relevance is minimal.
